text:
alex: Heads-up: QuantaGrid wants a joint perf/W bench for marketplace listing. Scope: throughput at rack level, kernel tuning to reduce p95, and verified watt-per-token. Need matrix + telemetry + PR plan.

maria: +1. Proposed minimal matrix: models [redwood-3b,redwood-7b], quants [fp16,int8], batch [1,4], seq [512,1024], runs 3. Capture board_power_w and rack_power_w.

tom: I'll own the runbook and CI integration. We should standardize the command and add `--rack-measure` that pings PDUs. Example:
```
./qbench --model redwood-3b --batch 4 --seq 1024 --quant int8 --runs 3 --rack-measure --out s3://partnerships/quantagrid/3401234567/
```

jin: I'll update the Prom exporter to add labels: lab, rack_id, pdu_channel. Metrics: gpu_power_w, rack_power_w, tokens_total, latency_ms_hist. PromQL for watt_per_token: `sum(rate(rack_power_w[1m]))/sum(rate(tokens_total[1m]))`.

eva: Legal note: QuantaGrid asked for a short tech annex describing kernel patches. They will host tuning in their secure lab; no kernel binaries to leave their network. We'll need a 1-page rollback and safety checklist.

alex: Good. Marketing will want a one-liner for the marketplace entry but we agree not to publish numbers until both labs sign-off and SI verifies rack-level power. Who drafts?

maria: I'll draft the telemetry schema and CSV columns: model,batch,seq,quant,avg_gpu_w,rack_w,tokens_s,p95_ms,energy_j_per_token,run_id. Pushing to GH issue today.

tom: bench-bot smoke ran: 2/3 runs OK, one failure due to PDUs not responding on pdu_channel 4. Logs in s3://bench/quanta/3401234567/logs.tar.gz.

bench-bot: Created issue #5882 "QuantaGrid bench: matrix + rack-measure + annex" and added CI artifacts.

jin: I'll add pdu health checks and retry logic. Also emit peak_power_w metric.

eva: Schedule: 10-day tuning window in partner lab, weekly sync. QuantaGrid requests a short non-technical blurb for their marketplace page once numbers are signed.

alex: Action items: maria telemetry schema (EOD), tom runbook + retry logic (tomorrow), jin exporter changes (tomorrow AM), eva coordinate legal annex (today). Weekly sync set for Friday 3401242167.

maria: :thumbsup: will upload schema.

tom: Opening PR with runbook and example commands now. Tagging bench and infra.

bench-bot: Reminder: QuantaGrid weekly sync Friday 3401242167 (calendar invite created).
